_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to <project>/meta/shortlist.json and fill in for the house
you are covering. This file is deliberately generic: the skill never ships
a roster of real people (non-negotiable #6). Names, parties and portfolios
belong to the project, not to the skill, because they change every term.
'detectable' is DERIVED from whether a reference photo exists on disk -- do
not type it by hand. A person with tier 1 and detectable=false is a stated
intention, not coverage: the pipeline cannot see them at all.
Leave 'role' or 'party' as an empty string when it is not independently
confirmed. A wrong designation in a caption is worse than a missing one.

tiers.1: Top priority. Face goes on the thumbnail, words go in the title.
tiers.3: Publish only when the moment itself is newsworthy.

roster_verified: YYYY-MM-DD; who set these tiers, and what 'sitting' was checked against.

people.name: Full Name
people.note: Multiple references average out lighting and angle -- see reference/vip-packaging.md.

people.name: Another Name
people.note: Tier 1 but no reference photo: currently invisible to the pipeline.
